column1: # Words of a language that render no word of the original of their own, or only a particle: articles, conjunctions,
#   particles, pronouns, prepositions, auxiliaries. Ours; edit a row and run forge build (each product made with the list
#   declares this file). The English rows are the list the ASV's Strong layers were measured with (TSK-1890).
#   The Greek rows (Brenton's article, καί/δέ and prepositions as printed) send a CATSS phrase's article, conjunction and
#   preposition to their own kind, and its other words to the content words,
#   when Swete, Ottley or Brenton's English are composed through Brenton's Greek (TSK-1939).
# Columns: language (the text's declared language), word (as printed, case aside), kind.
#   article, conjunction, connective, particle   a composition carries a phrase's word of these kinds only to an original
#                    word of the same kind (MappingLinks.Targets, PRB-1916): article to the article; conjunction to a
#                    conjunction; connective (an adverb that joins clauses: then, so, now, when, as) to a conjunction or an
#                    adverb; particle to a particle or an interjection
#   pronoun, preposition, auxiliary, determiner, adverb   carried as every other word of the phrase is
#   every kind       the ASV's laid numbers fill none of them (StrongNumberSource.LaidRules), and a clause particle Maxfield
#                    puts on a content word is dropped unless every word of the phrase is one (MaxfieldAsvEdition)
